name: plantcraft94.newtonsoft.json-for-unity.converters
description: This package contains converters to and from common Unity types (Vector2, Vector3, Matrix4x4, Quaternion, Color, Bounds, ScriptableObject, and more). Compatible with Unity 6.6 (6000.6) and works seamlessly with both official com.unity.nuget.newtonsoft-json and jillejr.newtonsoft.json-for-unity.
author: plantcraft94

samples.description: Sample scenes, addressables configurations, and resources demonstrating Unity converter usage.
